item.title: The mortality gap between Black and White Americans keeps shrinking
item.dc:creator: elijah wolfson
item.description: The gap in the number of excess deaths between Black Americans and White Americans shrank significantly between 1993 and 2023, according to a new study.

item.title: Sticker shock looms as major challenge for single-payer health care push
item.dc:creator: Markian Hawryluk | KFF Health News
item.description: Any discussion of a universal health plan in the U.S. always comes with concerns about massive costs. Americans already spend more than $5 trillion on health care each year.
